scope: SnakZap Phase 4 Completion - D04 Hyperlocal Heatmap (discovery) + W14 Smart Watch App (wear, minimal payloads) + L15 VIP Customer Support (support) + admin ops console + consumer VIP badge

functional.evidence: 292/292 tests across 36 files (Task 18 baseline 275 + 17 new Task 19 tests); turbo typecheck 5/5. New D04 tests (4): empty grid stays under 500 bytes; 30-min window bucketing rounds coords to 3 decimals (~110 m cells) with counts merged per cell and sorted desc; DRAFT/PAYMENT_FAILED/CANCELLED excluded, PICKED_UP retained; orders older than the window dropped. New W14 tests (5): 401 without token; active-orders payload carries ONLY order_id/restaurant_name/status/pickup_time and JSON.stringify stays < 500 bytes; terminal orders excluded; one-tap reorder returns {order_id,status,total_amount} under 500 bytes and creates a fresh order; reorder with no history -> 404 NO_ORDERS. New L15 tests (8): 401s; 51 eligible orders -> VIP (order_count 51, spend 5100, thresholds exposed); Rs 5200 spend with 26 orders -> VIP; DRAFT/PAYMENT_FAILED/CANCELLED excluded (50 eligible -> not VIP); non-VIP ticket -> MEDIUM priority + null assignee; VIP ticket -> HIGH priority + auto-assigned OPS_AGENT + audit support_ticket_created; empty subject -> 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

security.evidence: All L15/W14 support+wear routes behind authenticate (401 without token, live-verified); heatmap is a public aggregate (no PII, counts only) consumed by the ops console; VIP thresholds computed server-side from eligible order statuses only (no client-supplied tier); audit trail support_ticket_created / wear_orders_listed / heatmap_queried recorded; ticket subject/description zod-validated (length caps).

performance.evidence: D04 aggregates in a single pass over the user's/global order set with a cutoff scan, one count per 3-decimal cell, O(cells) response (< 500 bytes when empty); W14 emits strictly flat glanceable objects - no items/pricing/PII - verified < 500 bytes by test; reorder reuses OrderingService.placeOrder (single pricing pass); heatmap route only scans orders with created_at inside the window.

resilience.evidence: Empty order store returns a valid zeroed heatmap (no divide-by-zero; maxCount guarded to >= 1); DRAFT orders can be reordered into a fresh DRAFT without touching the fulfillment state machine; support service emits VipTicketCreated after persistence; audit writes never block the response path; 30s polling in the ops console tolerates transient API errors and auto-recovers.

notes: Reordering reuses the existing OrderCreated event via OrderingService.reorder - deliberately no dedicated WearOrderReordered event to avoid event-catalog duplication.
VIP rules mirror insights semantics: only real fulfillment statuses count toward order_count and total_spend.
Admin ops console (/heatmap) is the first real page in the previously-empty admin scaffold; it polls GET /api/v1/discovery/heatmap every 30 s and renders a 24x24 teal dot-grid (~110 m cells).
Watch payload byte size asserted by Buffer/JSON stringify in tests (< 500 bytes) as required by the minimal-payload strategy.

In-memory repositories stand in for Postgres (Drizzle schema + migrations committed in Task 18); live API :3001 verified for all three new route families (heatmap 200 / wear 401 / support 401 without token).
